fullContentHtml:
BPSC Auditor Mains Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the Mains Notification for the post of Auditor. This recruitment has been announced for 102 posts. Online applying process for BPSC Auditor Mains Online Form 2026 will Start from 29 October 2026 & Candidate can apply till 16 November 2026. Candidates who appeared in Pre Exam are eligible to apply for the Bihar BPSC Auditor Mains Online Form 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 05 February 2026
  • Last Date : 26 February 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 05 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 28 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 02 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 13 July 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 31 July 2026
  • OMR Sheet : 06-12 August 2026
  • Result : 06-12 August 2026
  • Apply Mains From : 29 October to 16 November 2026

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Bank Charge : Extra
  • For Mains Exam : Rs. 00/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

BPSC Auditor Mains Online Form 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
